Devran Dennis Joó Inhaber – PrimeClean Facility Management
PrimeClean Facility Management wird von einem erfahrenen Dienstleister mit langjähriger Tätigkeit im öffentlichen Dienst geführt.
Die berufliche Laufbahn war geprägt von Verantwortungsbewusstsein, strukturiertem Arbeiten und einem hohen Maß an Diskretion – Werte, die heute konsequent in der professionellen Objektbetreuung umgesetzt werden.
Zuverlässigkeit, klare Abläufe und langfristige Zusammenarbeit stehen im Mittelpunkt der Unternehmensphilosophie.

**Considering New Web Content**

I am now focusing on integrating the owner's details, Devran Dennis Joó, into the "PrimeClean" website. I have an image to work with and a basic text description: "Devran Dennis Joó Inhaber – PrimeClean Facility Management." I am exploring the best placement and visual presentation for this new section.


**Refining Owner's Profile**

I'm now focusing on crafting the "Owner" or "About the Owner" section for the PrimeClean site, aiming for a professional feel consistent with the existing design. I am going to integrate the information about Devran Dennis Joó. I've decided to place it before the "Arbeitsweise" section to maintain narrative flow. I'm prioritizing conveying the owner's background in public service, emphasising responsibility, structure, and discretion. The section will highlight reliability, clear processes, and a commitment to long-term partnerships.


**Implementing Founder Component**

I am now creating the `Founder.tsx` component and will integrate it into the `App.tsx` file. The plan includes using the given text description and a placeholder for the provided portrait, planning a responsive layout. The component will display the image alongside text, adapting to screen size, so I'm implementing a side-by-side display for desktop and stacked for mobile. My next step involves reviewing the "Arbeitsweise" section to assess if any merging or refinement is needed.


**Designing Founder Display**

I'm now focusing on the visual design. My primary goals are a clean, professional aesthetic using the existing blue and slate color scheme and high-quality typography. The image, although I only have a placeholder for now, should have a professional frame—perhaps rounded corners and a subtle shadow. I've decided to create a dedicated "Das Gesicht hinter PrimeClean" section instead of integrating it with the existing "Arbeitsweise" section. I will then update `App.tsx` and create a `Founder.tsx` component to handle this modular display.


**Integrating Founder's Image**

I'm now focusing on how to handle the image integration for Devran's profile. Since I can't directly use a provided image, I'll need to use a descriptive placeholder and instruction for the user to upload the image later. I've re-examined the `App.tsx` structure and am deciding whether to combine the "Founder" section with an existing one. I'm exploring replacing the `Methods` section with a "Founder & Philosophy" section or adding the `Founder` section after the "About" section. My goal is a smooth integration with the current structure.
